chart: One MLP layer of Qwen3.8-27B (gate, up and down projections) in training memory: fully trained in BF16 vs QLoRA (frozen 4-bit + rank-16 adapter), plus the low-rank shape of the adapter

layer.note: 0.40% of an MLP layer; 0.30% over the whole model (79.7M of 26.9B), because the vocabulary matrices and the linear-attention projections carry no adapter

low_rank.idea: W stays frozen; the update is B times A, which squeezes 5,120 inputs down to 16 numbers and expands them back to 17,408 outputs
